desc: 六角浸塑哑铃套图：成对主图、平头防滚卖点、材质微距与多色矩阵
leaf: 氯丁橡胶浸塑六角哑铃
name: 家用浸塑六角哑铃套组款

shots.intent: 搜索结果里一眼点击，用成对摆位展示成套到手，白底合规无干扰。
一秒讲清平头端面落地稳、不滚动滚落的核心利益。
用圆头器械滚落与地面凌乱的对照放大收纳与安全隐患。
用连续浸塑表层与无缝包边的微距证明握感与做工。
把成对器械放进真实居家训练角，让买家代入自家空间。
保留双栏勾叉对照结构，让买家自行带入普通款与本款差异。
用正侧轮廓与空白引线交代单只大小与握位比例，消除尺寸疑虑。
同机位多色并列加空白标签条，让买家按配色与梯度自选组合。
用做工实证细节与留空凭证位收尾降风险，不承诺任何资质数据。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots, cool light grey panel #E9ECEF for claim and comparison screens, one warm wood-floored room environment for the lifestyle scene
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and bare geometric glyph plates in graphite #2B2E33 with one vivid orange #E8622A accent, always left unlabelled
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with a front-left soft key and gentle fill, controlled narrow sheen on the dipped coating, true soft contact shadows, one consistent light direction across every panel
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium home-strength ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, cool light grey panel #E9ECEF, graphite charcoal text #2B2E33 and one vivid orange accent #E8622A used sparingly; neutral studio colour temperature; modern geometric sans-serif kept for empty placeholder plates only, no rendered words or digits; clean seamless studio backdrops or one warm wood-floored room, no gradients or random textures; bright even high-key lighting with a front-left soft key, gentle fill, controlled narrow sheen on the dipped coating and true soft contact shadows; thin single-weight line icon style; stable product scale and the same slight 3/4 packshot angle with broad flat end faces kept blank; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no legible text, numerals or weight marks anywhere in frame
style.presentationRules: same slight 3/4 packshot angle and product scale across the whole set, broad flat end faces always presented blank, pairs laid diagonally or stacked, no product part cropped
style.surfaceSystem: matte cool grey studio board #E9ECEF for desk screens, warm oak plank floor #DCC3A3 for the room scene
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for empty placeholder plates only, no rendered words or digits
